verdict.rationale: Veriff advertises itself as a 'no-code identity verification solution' and offers a Customer Portal for manual review and verification management, suggesting some non-engineering configuration is possible, but there is no evidence detailing conditional-step logic, risk-based routing, country-specific requirement configuration, or template changes made without an engineering deploy. missing for 10: documented portal UI for conditional/risk-based routing rules, country-specific requirement configuration, template/flow editing without code, and independent confirmation these changes require no deploy.
